nodes.label: Borderless windows covering the screen count too. Browsers, video players and presentations are ignored.
Turns on while the active window belongs to an application whose .desktop file lists the Game category. Launchers are tagged as games too, so they are skipped.
Turns on while a program that Windows recognized as a game (the Game Bar list) runs. Launchers are listed there too, so they are skipped.
Games from the Game Bar list

Games that launchers or the system report count only while their window is active, so switching to a browser turns game mode off. Steam on Windows does not tell which program is the game, so its games always count.
Only while the game is in front
Turns on while a game runs through umu-run. Heroic, Lutris, Faugus Launcher and other launchers use it to start Windows games with Proton.
Turns on while a game started by Heroic Games Launcher runs (Epic, GOG, Amazon and added games): Heroic passes HEROIC_APP_NAME to every game it starts.
Turns on while a game started by Lutris runs: Lutris starts every game through lutris-wrapper.
Turns on while Steam runs a game: Steam starts every game through reaper SteamLaunch, and game windows have the ID steam_app_<number>.
Turns on while the active window is a nested gamescope session.
Turns on while a game runs through gamemoderun or requests GameMode itself. In Steam set the launch options to “gamemoderun %command%”.

Game mode turns on rules and automatic layout rules that have a game-mode condition. Automatic layout rules apply only when the layout is chosen automatically (Layouts page). Auto uses the detection sources and custom rules below; On and Off set the state manually. “Never a game” takes priority over automatic detection and “Always a game”. You can also change the mode in the top bar, in the tray menu or with a key bound to a game mode action.
